evals.prompt:
我需要对这条 Doris SQL 做完整性能分析，输出正式报告。SQL:

SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, COUNT(o.order_id) as order_cnt, SUM(o.amount) as total_amount
FROM ods_prod.user_info u
LEFT JOIN ods_prod.order_info o ON u.user_id = o.user_id
WHERE o.create_time >= '2026-01-01' AND o.create_time < '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.user_name
HAVING order_cnt > 5
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 100;
evals.expected_output: 触发 skill，走完整流程：解析表名→问询约束→获取DDL→生成影子表脚本→ANALYZE TABLE→获取执行计划→分析→生成含P0/P1/P2优先级的报告
expectations: Output includes performance_report.md at performance-reports/<timestamp>/
Report contains table structure analysis section
Report contains execution plan analysis
Report contains bottleneck identification with P0/P1/P2 priority labels
Report contains specific, actionable optimization suggestions
Report mentions ANALYZE TABLE as a step
Report asks about constraints (table modification permissions) or mentions them

evals.prompt:
帮我看看这条 Doris SQL 为什么慢，给优化建议：

SELECT a.*, b.class_name, c.teacher_name
FROM ods_stu.score a
JOIN ods_stu.class b ON a.class_id = b.class_id
JOIN ods_stu.teacher c ON b.teacher_id = c.teacher_id
WHERE a.score < 60
ORDER BY a.score;
expectations: Output includes performance_report.md
Report identifies why the query is slow (specific bottlenecks)
Report provides specific SQL optimization suggestions
Report checks for common optimization patterns (EXISTS→SEMI JOIN, redundant JOIN, bucket analysis)

evals.prompt:
Doris 分桶策略怎么评估？我要分析这条 SQL：
SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ods_hr.employee WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY department_id;
evals.expected_output: 触发 skill，特别是分桶评估相关分析
expectations: Output includes bucket strategy analysis
Bucket analysis provides specific bucket count recommendations (not just general advice)
Analysis references doris_analyze_table_storage or explains how to evaluate buckets
Report identifies whether the employee table has appropriate bucketing for the GROUP BY
